paraphrased_observation: H2-01 has operated since November 2021 at 15 MW IT. Following H2-02 inauguration, combined H2 IT capacity was 27 MW, with ultimate potential up to 600 MW. Solar nameplate generation of up to 30 MW is a separate asset.
notes: Body event date 2023-06-22; webpage migrated in 2026. Historical 27 MW H2 total differs from current DC001 30 MW.
